editorNote: OpenAI says its models are coming to Google Cloud, which opens a second major cloud route to them. Security is the other thread: OpenAI's Patch the Planet program is tied to the newly disclosed PHP vulnerabilities, and reports say attackers exploited them before patches shipped. Also in view: DeepSeek's open inference stack and Anthropic's new Claude Duet agent.
